Routing/tees fine. Black calm pick 4-wood aimed 40 yds left lands 286 yds out at the inside of the dogleg-left corner, at the cart path with trees left/long (51% trees/water/OB in the pattern). A straighter, shorter club (long iron / hybrid down the right-centre, as the Blue set picks) is the sensible play. Pick is a model output; flagged, no geometry fix.

Black tee was walked back 28 yds from the Blue box to match the 419 card yardage, which puts it on the 15th green (11 m from the 15th green centre). There is no tee box behind the Blue box on the photo (water left, cart path and 15th green behind). Move the Black tee to the back of the rearmost OSM box (Blue box, ~393 yds); the card's 419 cannot be found on the ground.
